decision_conditions:
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are first occupied in association with the approved use.

Condition : 4 - The use of the ground floor retail units shall be for Class A3 uses only, or any other Class A retail use class that the Use Class Order 1987 (or any subsequent act amending this) allows in its provisions. The residential uses above the retail units shall be for Class C3 dwelling units only and any change of use or subdivision shall require the formal consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.
Condition : 6 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the Samples of Materials for balcony and terrace railings, fences, river wall and patio of the development hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 8 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 9 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 08.00 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - The access doorways to the enlarged retail units shall have and maintain: a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground

Condition : 11 - Before the Class A3 use commences in either unit, the details of the respective means of ventilation, filtration and extraction for each unit's kitchen shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council and then installed in accordance with those details and maintained in working order.
Condition : 12 - No new windows, doors or openings to be inserted into any external wall or roof without the Council's written consent.
Condition : 13 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: Monday-Saturday 09.00 - 23.30 and 11.00 - 22.00 on Sundays. -
Condition : 14 - Shopfronts and/or fascia signs to both units shall clearly display the street number and/or postal address of the relevant unit(s) on the streetwards side.

Condition : 15 - Before the uses in the retail units commence, access ramps detailed on the amended plan received by fax on page no 002 and 003 and dated 06/01 2004 shall be constructed and installed in accordance with those plans and retained and maintained in a safe and usable condition.

Condition : 16 - Before any work commences, details of how the trees, canal bank, and watercourse are to be protected during construction works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council and then implemented on site by the developer and maintained until construction is completed. All materials and structures should then be removed and the canal bank area landscaped in accordance with details to be agreed on condition 7.

Condition : 17 - No development approved by this permission shall be commenced until a hydraulic study has been carried out, to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority, to determine the flood water level likely to apply to the site.  The study shall take climate change into account for the design life of the development.

Condition : 18 - Details of the works to the river wall must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and carried out before the rest of the development commences, to ensure the stability of the wall and its consequential impact on the stability of the flood defence wall.

Condition : 19 - The flood defence wall shall be raised to the required flood level to ensure that the development is protected from flooding during its lifetime.  Details of the works to the flood defence wall must be submitted to within one month of a flood that rises above the current flood wall height and be approved by the Local Planning Authority, and implemented within one calendar month from the date of approval.

Condition : 20 - Details of the float alarm system, to be installed on the riverward side of the flood defence wall, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and implemented prior to first occupation of the development.  The system shall be maintained in good operational order throughout the life of the development.

Condition : 21 - The vegetated area between the proposed development and the watercourse shall be retained as a vegetated buffer zone.  All planting shall be of native species, of UK genetic origin only.
description: Redevelopment of site incorporating enlargement of existing A3 use, demolition of existing rear extension and the erection of two storey rear extensions linked by roof terraces and a first floor balcony to site.
